subject: EvoCorp MAP: Launch orchestration & ownership clarifications
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Patel <diane.patel@evocorp.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@evocorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EvoCorp MAP: Launch orchestration & ownership clarifications

Hi Diane / Tom —

Thanks again for signing the SOW last week. I wanted to kick off a short MAP (mutual action plan) thread so we have a single place to agree owners, dates, and success criteria for the evaluation window and the first production rollout. Attached is a first-draft MAP spreadsheet that breaks tasks into Sales -> CS -> Eng -> Customer actions.

Key items I propose we lock today:
- Evaluation window: 4 weeks (pilot) starting 2028-08-06
- Canary rollout target: 2028-09-03
- CS owner: Laura Bennett (cc'd)
- SE support: Chloe Martin (cc'd)

Please confirm: 1) the internal EvoCorp stakeholders who will be responsible for the pilot (ops + product), 2) any procurement/contract steps we need to finish before 2028-08-06, and 3) whether the proposed evaluation metrics (latency SLA, 95th p95 < 250ms; model accuracy threshold: pass rate >= 92% on benchmark set) look right.

Attachments: EvoCorp_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), SLA_summary.pdf (summary of proposed runtime SLOs).

Short next steps from my side: I will add Laura to the SOW and share the onboarding runbook. Laura — would you like to set the first CS checkpoint call early next week?

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Diane Patel <diane.patel@evocorp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@evocorp.com>, procure@evocorp.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EvoCorp MAP: Launch orchestration & ownership clarifications

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear plan and the draft MAP. Quick responses below:

- Confirming pilot stakeholders: Diane Patel (Ops) and Tom Huang (CTO) will own the evaluation on the EvoCorp side. I will add Sarah Kim (product) to the kickoff invite once we have a date.
- Procurement: we've routed the SOW to procurement (procure@evocorp.com). They have one API/data residency question — can your security team confirm that logs and KV cache are not stored outside our VPC for the private deployment option? If needed we can take that offline with your security contact.
- Evaluation metrics: latency SLA looks fine; we want an additional metric for cost per 1k tokens so we can estimate monthly run-rate during pilot.

We are fine with the 4-week pilot starting 2028-08-06, pending procurement sign-off. Please share the onboarding runbook and a proposed calendar for checkpoints.

Regards,
Diane Patel
Head of Customer Ops, EvoCorp
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Patel <diane.patel@evocorp.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@evocorp.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, procure@evocorp.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EvoCorp MAP: Launch orchestration & ownership clarifications

Hi Diane / Tom — great to meet you both (virtually). I’ll own the customer success side and will run the onboarding and pilot orchestration. I reviewed Markus’s MAP and attached a short onboarding runbook with proposed checkpoints. Highlights and owners: 

- Week 0 (pre-pilot): environment & keys, DocuSign + access (Owner: EvoCorp ops), procurement confirmation (Owner: EvoCorp procure)
- Week 1: test corpus ingestion + baseline eval (Owner: Chloe Martin + EvoCorp product)
- Week 2: integration smoke tests, latency tuning (Owner: Redwood SE — Chloe)
- Week 3: collect evaluation metrics, run quality regression checks (Owner: Laura)
- Week 4: pilot wrap + decision meeting (Owner: Diane / Tom)

Action items for this week (assigned):
- Laura: schedule recurring weekly checkpoints (30m) starting week of 2028-08-07.
- Chloe: prepare baseline evaluation notebook and test dataset (due 2028-07-26).
- Markus: confirm signed SOW is uploaded to the HubSpot deal record and share DocuSign link.

Attachments: Onboarding-Runbook.pdf (10 pages, checklist + sample playbook).

If procurement needs a security contact, please loop in s_security@redwood.ai — happy to set a short call to answer residency/KV cache questions. Diane — does Friday 2028-07-22 at 11:00am PT work for a 30m kickoff?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Patel <diane.patel@evocorp.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@evocorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, chloe.martin@redwood.ai, procure@evocorp.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EvoCorp MAP: Launch orchestration & ownership clarifications

Perfect — thanks everyone. Diane: Friday 2028-07-22 11:00am PT is on my calendar. I uploaded the fully executed SOW to the HubSpot record and attached the signed copy here for procurement.

Attachment: Signed_SOW_EvoCorp.pdf (SOW signed 2028-07-18)

Final notes:
- We’ll track MAP tasks in the shared spreadsheet (EvoCorp_MAP_v1.xlsx) and I’ll keep the HubSpot deal updated.
- Laura will be the single-thread owner for the pilot; Chloe will be the primary SE for tuning and the baseline notebook.

See you Friday.

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
